$comment: Orders on the kernel (lib/order-records.js, owner Commerce): each order is a node of the commerce.order kind in its store's namespace, with the facts that make the deal — its number, status, amounts, currency, why it was cancelled and when it was delivered — as versions in time, so its status history is answerable at any instant. Its lines (the offerings bought, how many, at what price) are recorded as they were at checkout; the person who placed it is a relationship. The buyer's name, address and email stay in the orders table: an order is kept for the law, its personal data is not copied.
